camera.shot_scale_bias: large-format wide shots cut against tight faces
camera.height: eye level, moving with the action

lens.dof: deep focus so the scale of the location stays legible

sources: hard practical sources built into the set
lighting.practicals: everything looks physically lit on location rather than added later

rules: horizon lines kept level even in motion
composition.movement_of_subject: the subject moves with urgency through a physically real space

sound.ambience_bias: wind, engines, structural groans and heavy physical impacts

music.instrumentation: A rising brass ostinato over a ticking percussive pulse
music.dynamics: accelerating and layering continuously without release

must_include: the location is real and at full physical scale
the camera moves with the action rather than observing it from outside

notes: Practical locations at scale, cool naturalistic light, relentless forward momentum in both camera and cutting.
